_comment: The build-ready specification produced by the 2026-09-05 session. NOT YET BUILT as of that date - no post-installation sweep exists.
status: DESIGNED - not yet installed, not yet verified

supports.name: Feed + transformer + choke
supports.note: Horizontally fixed. Raised from the original 10 ft; that alone is worth about +1.0 dB.

supports.name: Apex tree - throw line + counterweight
supports.note: Sits at 17.86 m of wire - beside the 19.8 m voltage maximum on 40 m and 20 m. Needs the best insulator on the antenna.

supports.name: Far support - SE treeline
supports.note: Deliberately at 29.7 m of wire - the 40 m AND 15 m current maximum. Placement verified to cost nothing in average height versus a free optimum.

supports.name: End tie-off
supports.note: High-voltage node. Keep 6-8 ft clear of trunk and foliage and out of reach - kilovolts at 150 W.

wire_budget.slack_note: Lengths are straight-line. Add 2-3% slack; expect 8-12 in of mid-span sag at 6-9 lbf tension. Effective average height lands about 1 ft below the calculated figure once sag is included.

predicted_performance.40m_80m_note: At 0.30 lambda and 0.15 lambda the lobe points essentially straight up and the azimuth pattern collapses to near-omnidirectional. Ideal for continental US with no skip zone; orientation is irrelevant below 20 m.

mechanical.rope: 3/16 or 1/4 in Dacron / polyester, UV-stable. NOT nylon (4-8% water uptake, stretches). NOT cheap polypropylene (UV-dead in a season).
mechanical.insulators: 12-24 in glazed ceramic or UHMW at every rope-to-wire junction
mechanical.counterweights_lb: 5-10, on the free rope end or via a pulley to a ground anchor
mechanical.clearance: wire 3+ ft clear of limbs and trunk; 6-8 ft at the end tie-off
mechanical.principle: The wire NEVER touches the tree. Rope does. Wet bark is not the failure mode - wet rope is, and material choice plus a ceramic link solves it.

electrical.choke: 10 turns RG-8X on an FT240-31 at the transformer, plus a second at the shack entry
electrical.counterpoise_m: 5-8, bonded to the transformer ground, run away from the wire's direction
electrical.choke_evidence: The GOWENIC test in this repo moved resonance 2.6 kHz just from re-routing 12 ft of unchoked coax.
electrical.counterpoise_evidence: On the GOWENIC build a 96-inch counterpoise took 15 m from SWR 4.59 to 1.89 and 10 m from 1.81 to 1.68.

open_items: Verify the cylindrical object (propane tank?) about 9 m from the feed at bearing 142 deg, 26 ft laterally from leg 1
Verify a usable 50 ft limb exists at the far_support coordinates on the SE treeline
Sweep after installation and file the result under ../measurements/
Consider going higher than 50 ft - each 10 ft is worth about 0.9 dB
